_comment: Fixed in-context examples (protocol Section 6). Both images are crops centred on C02 of the DEVELOPMENT scene arc-n05-0000 (train split), rendered 2026-11-03 by scripts/dev/render_examples.py (Insert(C01), Pull(C01), Flatten(C02), then Insert(C02) primitive by primitive; provenance in examples/provenance_arc-n05-0000.json). Paths are relative to prompts/. Flatten has a verbal example only, as in the paper.

image_examples.text: Example 1 - zoomed view of clip C02. The head lies about 4 cm in front of C02's entry side and points along its arrow. No cable passes under C02's bridge yet. Correct decision: {"skill": "Insert", "target_clip": "C02", "done": false}

Example 2 - zoomed view of clip C02, the second clip of the route C01 -> C02 -> C03. The cable now goes under C02's bridge: one segment enters on the entry side, another comes out on the exit side, and the head lies a few centimetres beyond the exit. Correct decision: {"skill": "Pull", "target_clip": "C03", "done": false}

verbal_examples: Example 3 (no image) - after three consecutive Insert commands on C04, the head still lies beside C04, bent and parallel to its long axis, and no cable passes under C04's bridge. Correct decision: {"skill": "Flatten", "target_clip": "C04", "done": false}
